channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: Continuity of Care Improves TB Treatment Completion
item.description: A CureTB analysis found: 79% treatment completion after international relocation, with timelier linkage improving outcomes overall. The post Continuity of Care Improves TB Treatment Completion appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Effective Imaging Techniques in Survivors of Breast Cancer
item.description: Mammographic surveillance and adjunct imaging techniques can lower morality and enhance early detection among breast cancer survivors. The post Effective Imaging Techniques in Survivors of Breast Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Dengue Infection Raises Two Year Disability Burden
item.description: Dengue infection raised two-year hospitalization risk and added measurable disability burden in Singapore’s linked national cohort. The post Dengue Infection Raises Two Year Disability Burden appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI-Processed CECT Improves Unresectable Liver Cancer Management
item.description: Combining AI-processed CECT with clinical data improves the management of unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma, a 2026 study has found. The post AI-Processed CECT Improves Unresectable Liver Cancer Management appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Scientists Chart the Hidden Diversity of the Vaginal Microbiome
item.description: New algorithm maps hidden global and genetic diversity in vaginal microbiomes, offering precision tools for reproductive health research. The post Scientists Chart the Hidden Diversity of the Vaginal Microbiome appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: High Complete Response Rate with Neoadjuvant Pembrolizumab
item.description: Phase 2 findings show neoadjuvant pembrolizumab produced a 71% pathological complete response rate in resectable desmoplastic melanoma, with favourable safety and three year follow up outcomes. The post High Complete Response Rate with Neoadjuvant Pembrolizumab appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Medical Assistants Fail due to User Misinterpretation
item.description: A UK study shows AI medical assistants perform well alone but fail to improve public health decisions in practice. The post AI Medical Assistants Fail due to User Misinterpretation appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Stopping Washcloth Use May Reduce Pruritus, Study Suggests
item.description: Stopping washcloth use during bathing may significantly reduce chronic itch, according to a new observational dermatology study exploring simple lifestyle changes. The post Stopping Washcloth Use May Reduce Pruritus, Study Suggests appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Self-Management Intervention Targets Early Inflammatory Arthritis
item.description: A multicentre trial will assess whether a nurse led self management intervention improves skills and quality of life in adults with newly diagnosed inflammatory arthritis. The post Self-Management Intervention Targets Early Inflammatory Arthritis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Quantitative Coronary CT Plaque Measures Predict MACE Risk
item.description: Quantitative coronary CT plaque measures independently predicted major adverse cardiovascular events, improving risk stratification in patients. The post Quantitative Coronary CT Plaque Measures Predict MACE Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.
